newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks slip at noon in thin trading.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks slip at noon in thin trading.

text.p: Pakistan stocks slipped slightly at midday on Monday in lacklustre trading on lack of investor interest before the June 14 budget for fiscal 1997/98 (July-June), dealers said.
The index fell 1.29 points, or 0.09 percent, to 1,506.67 at midday. Losers outnumbered gainers 150 to 43.
"The market is directionless and is likely to remain so till the budget is announced," dealer Shakil Anwar said. "Even speculative activity has shrunk."
